topic_zh: Result 和 ? 运算符：错误处理
topic_en: Rust error handling: Result and the ? operator

xhs.title: Rust 没有异常，出错了怎么办？
xhs.body:
第 13 课：Result 和 ? 运算符
Rust 没有异常，可能失败的函数返回 Result：成功 Ok(值)，失败 Err(错误)
match：成功和失败两条路都写
unwrap：失败就 panic，正式代码少用
? 运算符：成功取值继续走，失败把错误返回给调用者
考考你：fn f() -> i32 { let n: i32 = "7".parse()?; n } 能编译吗？ 评论区告诉我～

douyin.body:

tiktok.body: Rust has no exceptions. Errors are values: Result, match, unwrap and the ? operator in one minute. Quick quiz: fn f() -> i32 { let n: i32 = "7".parse()?; n }  Does it compile? Comment your answer.

linkedin.title: Rust has no exceptions. Errors are values.
linkedin.body:
A function that can fail returns Result: Ok(value) or Err(error).
match handles both paths right where you are.
unwrap takes the value but panics on Err: fine for demos, risky in real code.
The ? operator takes the Ok value or returns the Err to the caller, so the function must return a Result itself.
Quick quiz: fn f() -> i32 { let n: i32 = "7".parse()?; n }  Does it compile? Answer in the comments.

quiz.q_zh: fn f() -> i32 { let n: i32 = "7".parse()?; n } 能编译吗？
quiz.q_en: fn f() -> i32 { let n: i32 = "7".parse()?; n }  Does it compile?
quiz.answer_zh: 答案：不能。? 遇到错误会把它从函数里返回出去，所以对 Result 用 ?，函数自己也得返回 Result。f 返回的是 i32。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: no. On an error, ? returns it from the function, so the function must return a Result itself. f returns an i32.
